owner_instruction: Operate an online publisher and online editorial service at raumzeitterminal.de using the universal terminal and universal transputer, with an open question interface and evidence-bound answers for every user. Authorization explicitly granted.
out_of_scope: Unrelated private media, personal data and family content
Independent native Code Owner review impersonation
Automatic publishing to Zenodo, IETF or arXiv

answer_sections: Source URLs with retrieval dates and provenance
Evidence class: formal proof, measurement, test, theory, speculation or editorial opinion
Reproducible verification path and effect receipt
editorial_contract.safety: Rate limits, abuse prevention, personal data minimization, prompt injection isolation, no secret exposure, human editorial controls, audit privacy
editorial_contract.publication: Separate publication decision from interactive answer; no automatic promotion of user questions into published articles.

remaining_gates: Exact-head native CI and security/privacy tests for the question portal
Production-capable authenticated backend with bounded retrieval over qualified sources and a permitted AI inference route
Transputer runtime admission and observed EFFECT_ACK for each claimed external effect
Operator access and API-native deployment path without bypassing PR review, rulesets or protected Main
Domain DNS, TLS and routing to an accepted public runtime
Independent live questions/answers acceptance including no-answer cases and source provenance
Public HTTP readback and exact bytes of deployed assets
Editorial governance, terms, privacy policy and clear separation of scientific evidence and opinion

local_fixture_tests.scope: Nine defined HTTP contract tests plus three static UI contract tests; included in Makefile test target, native execution not yet verified

external_deployment_attempt.next_action: Owner/provider account plan activation required before retry; unchanged error must not be retriggered
